A — HOW TO USE THIS PROMPT IN CURSOR
THIS PROMPT TOUCHES UI FILES ONLY. No API routes, no engine services, no database schema, no prisma files, no worker files are modified. Read carefully before starting.

Prompt 3 (Erector Upgrade) must be complete and verified. The 10 validation screens must already exist in app/(validation)/. The validation API routes must already return data. This prompt only upgrades the visual layer of the existing results screen.
Step 2 — Open Cursor. Open the Torgima-Execution project.
Confirm you are on the correct branch. Confirm app/(validation)/ exists with existing screen files.
Step 3 — Paste this prompt into a new Cursor chat and send.

Cursor will read the existing validation result screen file, then replace only the JSX render output with the new 7-section layout. All existing hooks, data fetching, API calls, and state management remain untouched.
Step 4 — Run the dev server and verify all 7 sections render correctly before deploying.

The Erector validation results screen currently exists at app/(validation)/validation/[id]/scores/page.tsx or equivalent. It shows basic score data but is missing five of the seven sections required for a complete validation report.
This prompt upgrades the render output of that screen to the full 7-section layout:
Section 1 — Idea / Goal + Verdict + Confidence Score + Selected Path
Section 2 — Reality Scorecards (5 key scores as /100 with bars and tags)
Section 3 — Path Analysis (3-column comparison with RECOMMENDED badge)
Section 4 — Risk Summary (4 risk cards with severity badges and mitigations)
Section 5 — Opportunity Areas (5 strategic opportunity cards)
Section 6 — Blueprint Readiness (direction, target user, success definition, constraints, priority areas)
Section 7 — Ready to Execute (Launch Blueprint CTA + Download Report CTA)
The existing data-fetching logic, useEffect hooks, API client calls, and session/auth handling in the file are NOT replaced. Only the JSX return block is upgraded.
READ THE EXISTING FILE COMPLETELY BEFORE WRITING A SINGLE LINE. Understand all existing hooks, state variables, and data shapes before replacing the render.
DO NOT REMOVE ANY EXISTING IMPORT. Add new imports for icons or components only if they are not already present.
DO NOT CHANGE ANY API CALL, ROUTE, OR DATA FETCHING LOGIC. The new layout reads from the same validation data object the existing screen already fetches.
DO NOT MODIFY ANY OTHER SCREEN FILE. Only the validation results / scores screen is modified in this prompt.
EXECUTION LANGUAGE THROUGHOUT. No motivational copy. No 'Great job!', 'Amazing!'. Every label uses operational language. 'Validation complete.' not 'Your results are ready!'
ALL SCORES DISPLAY AS /100 NOT /10. Multiply existing 0-10 scores by 10 before display. The formula is: displayScore = Math.round(raw_score * 10).
CONFIDENCE SCORE IS THE COMPOSITE REALITY SCORE CONVERTED TO PERCENTAGE. Formula: confidenceScore = Math.round(validation.reality_score * 10).

The onboarding goal input screen currently exists at app/(onboarding)/onboarding/page.tsx. It collects a basic goal and purpose but does not cover location, business type, model, budget, resources, customer, or constraints — all of which are required by the Erector validation engines.

This prompt upgrades the onboarding screen to a full 5-step intake flow. The steps are rendered as a single-page multi-step form (no page navigation between steps — step state is managed in React state). The form collects every input required for POST /api/v1/validation/run.

READ the existing onboarding page completely before touching it. Understand existing form state, submission handler, and any Bhudhi structuring call. Preserve all of that logic. Only the UI is upgraded.
SINGLE PAGE — NO ROUTE CHANGES. All 5 steps live in one page component. Step progression is React state (currentStep: 1-5). No new routes are created. No router.push between steps.
PRESERVE EXISTING SUBMISSION HANDLER. The existing handler that calls /api/bhudhi/structure-goal and /api/onboarding/goal is kept. The form submits on Step 5 completion exactly as before.

FORM DATA SHAPE MUST MATCH ErectorValidationInput. Every new field added to the form must be included in the submission payload sent to /api/v1/validation/run. Add new fields to the existing form state object — do not create a separate state object.
IDEMPOTENCY KEY AUTO-GENERATED. Add: const idempotencyKey = useRef(crypto.randomUUID()). Include in submission payload. User never sees or sets this.

ARCHETYPE PREVIEW IS DISPLAY-ONLY. When the user enters a country, call GET /api/v1/validation/archetypes?country=[value] to fetch and display archetype preview in the sidebar. This is a non-blocking read call — it does not affect form submission.
Define this interface at the top of the file. Merge with any existing form state fields already present.
